title: Real-time Inventory Sync for Boutique Retail
business: A boutique retail chain managing high-turnover inventory across multiple physical locations and a web storefront.
problem: The business suffers from overselling items because their legacy database lacks a mechanism to push stock updates to client devices instantly, leading to manual reconciliation costs and customer dissatisfaction.
solution: Supabase provides a managed Postgres database with built-in Realtime functionality, allowing the application to broadcast database changes directly to connected client sessions without polling.
steps: Initialize the project using the Supabase CLI to establish the local development environment.
Define the inventory table schema within the Postgres database.
Enable Realtime on the inventory table to track row-level changes.
Implement a client-side subscription in the storefront application to listen for inventory updates.
Apply Row Level Security policies to ensure only authorized staff can modify stock levels.
outcome: The storefront reflects accurate, live inventory counts across all user sessions, effectively eliminating the risk of overselling popular items.
limitation: Realtime subscriptions consume database connection slots and memory; developers must monitor the number of active channels to ensure the database remains performant under heavy concurrent load.
